notes.title: Working on an Update - community Feedback Appreciated
notes.content:
Hi all!

So we have decided  to finally put some more work into making Box Maze a better game, the game has not been updated for quite some time and everyone who owns the game deserves some love :)

Please let us know of the following.

1. If you would like us to try add anything new to the game.
2. What you disliked, what annoyed you or what doesn't work well on the game.
3. Would you prefer the character artwork from Box Maze 2 in the game or do you prefer the old classic look.
4.  You can even suggest what music you would like in the game as we want to add more to remove the repetitive feeling.
5. Anything else you feel will help make the game more enjoyable.

Hoping to hear from old and new players :)

Much Love
Johan (A.K.A ABI7ITY)

notes.title: Out of Early Access :D
notes.content:
[h1]Ladies & Gentlemen[/h1]

We are extremely proud to announce that Box Maze has just left Early Access :)

We would like to thank each and everyone of you who have supported us with the game, to all the constructive criticism that has made the game so much better and to all the positive feedback we have received.

As with any game that has left Early Access we will continue to fix any issues you guys may find but we are confident that 99.9% of all bugs & issues have been dealt with in the latest update.

if you enjoyed the game please share the news with your friends and help us make Box Maze popular.

We will start working on new projects very shortly and already have some great ideas and can't wait to share them with you all.

[h1]Full Release Patch Notes:[/h1]

1. 25 brand new levels, now 100 in total.
2. 5 new hidden secrets, now 15 in total.
3. Development and publishing named as GamersHype.
4. Now has 170 Steam achievements.
5. Cupcakes removed from 1v1 Duel Arena (Cupcakes were not really needed for this game mode)
6. Added "Player 1 Wins!" and "Player 2 Wins" notifications to the 1v1 mode.
7. New enemy: Bomber box, throws bombs at the player dealing 50 damage on hit (can be restored with apple's)
8. Plus a couple more fixes and tweaks.
9. Issue Tracker removed from main menu.
10. Players have been using the Steam discussions instead so lets keep it that way :)
11. Settings renamed to change controls.
12. Fixed an issue where the deaths achievements would sometimes not work.

Much Love
ABI7ITY & Fay

notes.title: Patch Notes EA 1.0.0.6
notes.content:
1. 5 brand new levels.
2. Potion Inventory is now implemented in the bottom left corner of the game.
Potions info:
Blue, purple, red, green and orange potions have been added to single player, these potions will be stores and stacked in your inventory.
To use a potion simply click on the associated icon on the bottom of the screen , consuming a potion will kill off all of the same colour enemies in a level but use these wisely as they will only appear in some levels.
(Special thank you to community member imTrajPar for this awesome suggestion :)
3. Beta branch now open to the public.
For more info on the Beta branch please visit http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=793804015

Disclaimer: The Beta branch is an unreleased version of the game that may contain bugs, crashes, etc. We do not advise you to play on it unless you are aware of this and it doesn't bother you.

notes.title: Save & Load File Format Changed in New Patch.
notes.content:
Hi boys and girls.

With the new update we have made a major change to the way save and load games work which included changing the save format.

This may cause an issue with saved files from the previous version, if you encounter any issues please contact us with information of the last level you reached and we will gladly send you a file to fix the issue.

Note: We are aware of an issue where saving the game while you are on a moving platform and loading back in will cause the moving platform to load in its original position, we are working now on a hotfix for this, in the meantime to avoid the issue be sure to save on a non moving platform or block, if you experience this issue and your character gets stuck press the "M" button, jump back into the single or co-op game mode and press "L" to load at the start of the level.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause but rest assured the new format is much more stable and is a step ahead for the game :)

Much Love
ABI7ITY & FAY

notes.title: Patch Notes EA 1.0.0.2 (New Game Mode and More)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25936561/92ddeda48e497917ea95b9add5e085c95934d8bd.jpg[/img]
Includes the all new 1v1 Duel Arena game mode, new levels, fixes, new save and load system and much more...

1. Five new levels to single player and co-op.
1. Added a taste of the upcoming 1v1 Duel Arena (Currently has 3 levels which can be played over, you and your opponent can decide how many rounds you will play).
a. Save games and the timer have been discluded in 1v1, if you feel they should be included please let us know. :)
2. Game mode options can now be chosen by left clicking (Start Single Player, Start Co-Op and so forth).
3. Achievements are now accessible via the main menu.
4. Added a clickable menu option in each level.
5. Some small changes have been done to previous levels.

[b]Bug fixes (Our boxes have been doing what they do best, eating bugs :P)[/b]
1. The timer, score, deaths and so forth now no longer displays in the main menu.
2. Fixed a bug where falling to your death would bug the death counter at times.
3. Removed some enemy boxes that were being naughty.
4. Fixed an issue with 5000 points achievement not working.

[b]Upcoming in the next patch[/b]
Possibility that a character skins pack will be ready.
Pop up  "Player # Wins" in 1v1.
Power up items.
Five new levels to be added to single player and co-op.

Much Love
ABI7ITY & FAY

I happy to announce that a version of the 1v1 Duel Arena Game Mode will be available in the next update later this week.

It will be just a short best of 3 levels with player 1 vs player 2, the idea is to work on the features you want in this game mode before we begin adding new levels as well as a best of 5 and so forth.

Sorry for any inconveniences caused.

Sorry for any inconveniences caused.

notes.title: Closed Beta Keys Are All Out + Quick Update on the Game.
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who requested a beta key for pre release testing, we have run out of keys and we did receive more request's than expected.
I am hoping to have an exact release date within the next week or so but so far we will release on 30 September 2016 (Hopefully even before then).

This week we will be working on adding in game sound's and additional levels, as well as some tweaks to existing levels, Fay (our graphics designer) is back after being away in London for a month and she will also start working on the game graphics, trading cards, background, emoticons and all those fancy things that she does so well :)

Release date will then depend on how many levels the community will want before Early Access but remember even after the Early Access release we will be adding more levels weekly, our goal is to have hundreds of levels available to the player before we can move from Early Access into a full release, right now our plan is minimum 30 and not more than 50 levels before Early Access.

Let us know what you guys think in the comments section, after all this game will be community based :)

Lots of Love
ABI7ITY
